claims.text: Complete fixed subset/cover streams are replayed independently; new affine information is measured against existing preprocessing rows on unchanged original columns. No rank gain, cost rate or advantage is presumed.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic paired enumeration; no noisy comparative metric.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Baseline h0 is matched by active subset, original columns, preprocessing and sources; no presumed zero yield. Separate software corruptions test rejection.

positive.not_applicable_reason: No guaranteed witness in any fixed subset cell; independent complete replay checks every observed witness. Separate small software controls validate producer/checker paths.

decision_rule.statistic: Exact retained row equations, ranks and old-kernel products.
decision_rule.text: Report every matched subset/cover cell and exact new/combined ranks, rank gain over old M, syndrome and zero-witness counts. No scientific state or speed claim.
decision_rule.threshold: Complete fixed stream and separate independent arithmetic replay.

extensions.checkpoint_semantics: Actual canonical S3 gate mandatory; no in-row restore; retries use fresh directories and do not retain clock validity.
extensions.counter_coverage: Partial collection field/group counters omit independent replay, integer bookkeeping, affine/kernel work, preprocessing, storage and complete S; no cost rate claimed.
extensions.export_unit: Ten disjoint arm/candidate cells share one physical process; whole-process resources only in backend_record. Per-cell phase diagnostics are components, not extra executions.
extensions.verification_scope: Separate arithmetic checker replays branches/rows/statuses/new+combined ranks and old-kernel action; not independent scientific review or field-counter audit.

inadmissible: Executing before committed exact source, prospective freeze, canonical S3 gate and explicit root release.
Changing active subset between matched arms or accepting residuals outside it.
Replacing original columns/preprocessing/public sources or selecting by relation yield.
Adding shared process resources to phase components.
Complete S, Delta-per-cost, attack advantage or independent scientific review claim from partial counters.
invalidation_rules: Changed source/input, active subset, original projection/preprocessing or failed complete replay prevents verified observation.
Unknown/missing cells remain null, collected-but-unverified cells remain explicit.
Partial collection counters do not establish complete cost or Delta-per-cost.
